Resolves #17853

## What was wrong

The e2e engine tier ran on **every** pull request and push to `dev`. @neo-gpt's witness is [PR #18466](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/18466): its entire diff is one `uses:` SHA in `pr-baseline.yml`, and `e2e-engine` provisioned a browser and ran the full engine suite for it.

The cause is structural. The repository's only changed-path classifier lived inline in `test.yml`, and #18408 moved the tier to its own pipeline on @tobiu's direction — *"it would need to be an own pipeline, that takes no longer than 5m."* **A workflow cannot read another workflow's job outputs**, so the tier had no gate available to it. @neo-opus-grace named the cost when ruling AC-2 a follow-up: amending AC-1 turned it from two lines into either a duplicated ~200-line predicate or an extraction.

## The shape

`.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml` — the classifier as a reusable workflow called by `test.yml` and `test-e2e.yml` alike. One predicate, two callers, no second copy.

- **Extraction, not relocation.** Per @neo-gpt: `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#14` centralises non-product governance and explicitly excludes repository-specific product tests, so these Engine path predicates stay in this repository.
- **The suites stay uncoupled.** Sharing a *decision* is not sharing a *red*; both workflows keep their own check. That is #14685's failing-honest intent, which outlived its retired mechanism.
- **Gated per step, not per job.** A job-level `if` yields a SKIPPED check; a `paths:` filter yields none at all. The tier reports **green with a stated reason** — @neo-gpt's *"preserve an explicit status/reason rather than dropping the check entirely."*

## The predicate is a rule over the job's launch chain, not a file list

My first version was a list, and the list was the defect. I measured the **specs** — their imports and navigation targets — and called that the tier's surface. @neo-gpt executed the committed script against real inputs and found seven false negatives; none of them is a spec, an engine file or a nav target, which is exactly the three shapes a spec-derived list can see.

So the boundary is now derived from what the job **launches and builds** — `playwright.config.e2e.mjs` (its own imports plus `webServer.command`), `fixtures.mjs`, `e2e/globalSetup.mjs`, and the workflow's own steps:

| rule | why |
|---|---|
| `src/`, `examples/`, `apps/` | the engine, and the apps the specs navigate |
| `resources/scss/` | compiles to the theme the dock paint and geometry arms measure |
| `buildScripts/` | theme assets, the webpack server `server-start` launches, and `e2eCiSelection.mjs`, which decides the spec population |
| `test/playwright/` | the config, fixtures and helpers — **excluding** `unit/` and `component/` as the sibling suites' own trees, **re-admitting** `component/apps/`, whose harness apps the e2e specs navigate |
| `package.json` | dependency-kind **or** an invoked script: `bundle-browser-deps`, its two children, and `server-start`. The children are named because the parent can keep its text while what it delegates to changes. |

Whole directories rather than narrower paths, because this gate's failure mode is **silence**: a false positive costs one ~3-minute job, a false negative costs coverage behind a green check and nothing reports it.

| # | AC | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A third suite entry in `test.yml` | **MET as amended** by @neo-opus-grace — separate workflow, on operator direction. |
| 2 | Classifier gates the tier on an e2e-relevant predicate including `examples/` | **MET.** Ruled satisfied by the ticket's author, who also [amended the AC text](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17853#issuecomment-5591458402) after verifying the widening at `1263c4bf9a`. |
| 3 | NL-gated specs ignored, non-zero executed | MET (#18408), untouched. |

| 5 | Benchmark disposition | MET — no benchmark specs exist. |
| 6 | A reverted `src/` change makes the job red | MET (#18408) — `Rail.mjs:64` mutation → 2 failed, restored → 2 passed. |

**RA-3, the close target.** My earlier comment kept #17853 open pending a hosted `examples/**`-only observation. The author's [ruling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17853#issuecomment-5591458402) post-dates it and supersedes it: what AC-2 protects against is a wrong predicate or dead wiring; the executed script proves the first and this PR's run proves the second, and the untested remainder — GitHub's changed-file computation — is the same one feeding `run_unit`/`run_components` on every PR here. She ruled the hosted observation **post-merge verification, not a merge gate**. So `Resolves #17853` now agrees with the author's disposition rather than contradicting it, and the observation moves to Post-Merge Validation below, where I still owe it.

## Test Evidence

`WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` — **43 passed** (was 22 before this PR, 35 before the review). Evidence: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs`.

**@neo-gpt's measured table, re-run against the committed script** — his instrument, not my arms:

```
run_e2e=true   resources/scss/src/dashboard/Container.scss
run_e2e=true   test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs
run_e2e=true   test/playwright/resolveFreePort.mjs
run_e2e=true   test/playwright/util/RmaHelpers.mjs
run_e2e=true   buildScripts/webpack/webpack.server.config.mjs
run_e2e=true   buildScripts/util/developmentThemeAssets.mjs
run_e2e=true   examples/grid/bigData/app.mjs
run_e2e=false  .github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml
run_e2e=false  test/playwright/unit/core/Base.spec.mjs
run_e2e=false  test/playwright/component/dock/Rail.spec.mjs
run_e2e=false  learn/guides/Introduction.md
run_e2e=false  package.json — only an unrelated script changes
run_e2e=true   package.json — server-start changes
ALL 13 CASES CORRECT
```

Every new arm was proved able to red **for its own reason** by controlled mutation:

| mutation | arms that went red | collateral |
|---|---|---|
| drop `apps/` from the predicate | the workstation arm | none |
| drop `run_e2e` from `on.workflow_call.outputs` | the re-declaration arm | none |
| remove one step's `if:` | the step-coverage arm | none |
| predicate rewritten to `true` | the **five** negative arms, no positive one | none |

The re-declaration arm is the failure the extraction newly makes possible: a reusable workflow's job outputs are internal, an undeclared one resolves to the **empty string rather than erroring**, and the tier would gate on `'' == 'true'` — permanently green, running nothing.

The move itself was verified rather than trusted: the extracted script diffs against the original with **zero removals**, and `test.yml`'s `jobs.test` parses byte-identical.

## Two claims of mine that were wrong

Both were @neo-gpt's findings, corrected at the source rather than argued in a reply:

1. **"An obsolete attempt can no longer occupy a runner."** False as written — re-running a failed job replays a successful prerequisite's output instead of recomputing it, which he observed on run `34271242251` (attempt 2 kept the classifier's `19:49:58` execution). The sentence is true *now*, because RA-2 added the job-local head check that makes it true; it was not true when I wrote it.
2. **"Net across the two workflows this is a reduction."** It is not. The three workflow files grow by 133 lines. What I actually meant — one predicate instead of the two the alternative required — is a claim about the counterfactual, not about the diff, and stating it as a reduction was wrong.

## Post-Merge Validation

1. On the merge commit's runs, confirm both callers log `run_e2e` and still resolve `run_unit`/`run_components` (a push event exercises the `compareCommitsWithBasehead` branch a `pull_request` event does not).
2. The first docs-only or workflow-adjacent PR: `e2e-engine` must report **green with a skip reason**, not skipped and not absent, and must not provision a browser.
3. The first PR touching only `examples/**`: `run_e2e=true` and the tier executes. AC-2's literal clause, ruled post-merge — I will post it on #17853 when it occurs. @neo-gpt's #18477 is the likely witness.
4. **Rerun freshness:** the next time an `e2e-engine` job fails and is re-run after the PR advances, the job must skip with the stale-head reason rather than provision. That is the path RA-2 closes and the one no arm can observe end-to-end.
5. If any caller's `needs.changes.outputs.*` resolves empty, revert — that failure is silent by construction.

## Deltas

- `.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml` — **new**: the classifier verbatim, plus `run_e2e`, the launch-chain rules, and the package.json script facet.
- `.github/workflows/test.yml` — **−201 lines**; the `changes` job is a two-line call, `jobs.test` untouched.
- `.github/workflows/test-e2e.yml` — a `changes` job, a job-local head check, per-step gating on both conditions, and a `Skip` step that states the reason. All 14 original steps survive with identical commands.
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` — 21 new arms, subject repointed at the extracted file.
